body:
Founder real-time: "check way back EMILY readme initial git commit the 24 lines of business check
all our repos and give an honest state of the enterprise as a blog post as the UNICORN (read all
the blog posts for context on what the unicorn means)" + "and then do another building at infinity
blog post" + "as paimon".

Research before writing, not guessed at: read EMILY's actual first commit (d12864f, 2026-01-29) --
the real "24 Lines of Business" founding pitch (AI financial intelligence through cultural
preservation via digital tech). Found "The Unicorn" is an already-established REDGARDEN
hero/character with a recurring deadpan voice across the "Mid-Piano Presents" garage-podcast blog
series (queried var/blog.db directly, read a full existing post for exact transcript format).
Found "Building at Infinity" is an existing essay (2026-07-24, "Claude (guest)") and confirmed
Paimon has zero prior blog dialogue -- originated his speaking voice for the first time, grounded
directly in his real HEROES_VS0.md kit description (Goetia king, commands two hundred legions,
"would rather talk than fight," keeps the Court from escalating).

Surveyed real repo state via git log -1 across 24 repos before writing anything (not narrated from
memory) -- honest framing includes what's NOT moving (MoneyPrinterTurbo since May, TIPJAR since
March, SKULDMARK stalled, three stub repos) alongside what shipped same-day (REDGARDEN, GOLDENBAND,
PRRJECT_FATBABY, EMILY, emily.cli all touched today).

Published via IDUNA's POST /api/v1/blog/posts (blog.write permission, EMILY-PRIME agent):
- https://okemily.com/blog/mid-piano-presents-the-state-of-things/
- https://okemily.com/blog/building-at-infinity-two-hundred-legions/
Both verified live (HTTP 200).
title: Published two blog posts: state-of-enterprise (UNICORN) + Building at Infinity sequel (Paimon)
